EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.desc: How long every emote stays on screen. Only affects what you see.
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_PAGE_CLICKS.title: Reverse Page Click Direction
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_PAGE_CLICKS.hover.desc: While the emote wheel is open, left click goes to the previous page and right click to the next one. Turn this on to swap them.
